summary: Full-stack engineer focused on backend and platform work: third-party integrations, distributed data pipelines and AI-powered product features. I build in Node.js and TypeScript on AWS, with React on the front end, and I care about systems that stay correct under concurrency, retries and flaky upstream APIs.

experience.tagline: AI-powered candidate screening platform that plugs directly into recruiters' ATS.
highlights: Built four production ATS integrations end to end — BambooHR, Teamtailor, Pinpoint and Greenhouse Harvest v3 — covering OAuth connection flows, job and candidate sync, resume ingestion, and bidirectional write-back of stage moves, rejections, notes and AI scores.

Migrated the Greenhouse connector from Harvest v1 to the v3 Partner OAuth API using a dual-vendor model, so both versions ran side by side and existing customers migrated with no downtime and no re-onboarding.

Designed a cursor-paginated sync layer on AWS Lambda that streams ATS records into OpenSearch, with per-vendor rate limiting, exponential backoff on 429s and idempotent retries across resumable pages.

Built Candidate Pools, a conversational search experience combining hybrid retrieval over OpenSearch (keyword + vector embeddings), Cohere reranking served through Amazon Bedrock, and per-criterion AI evaluation of every shortlisted candidate with streaming UI updates.

Shipped Candidate Rediscovery, re-evaluating a company's entire historical ATS database against any new opening to turn dormant applicant data into a sourcing channel; rolled out progressively behind team-scoped feature flags.

Hardened the distributed import and evaluation pipeline on Redis-backed workers with claim-and-recover semantics for stale runs, enqueue deduplication and cancellation handling, eliminating stuck and double-completed jobs.
Implemented automated OAuth token rotation on AWS Secrets Manager for vendors issuing rotating refresh tokens, removing a recurring class of silent integration failures.

Developed AI-powered asset quality intelligence producing real-time health scores, compliance checks and automated correction suggestions across campaigns.

Implemented localisation across Spanish, English and Portuguese, including translation key management and regional variants.
Led a full-stack feature that improved application performance by 30%, using React on the front end and Node.js for backend processing.
Redesigned a core module's UI and backend architecture, raising user satisfaction and engagement by 25% through better data-access patterns and database management.
Introduced TypeScript across React and Node.js codebases, reducing runtime errors and improving maintainability for the whole team.
Implemented RESTful APIs and third-party integrations with secure data handling between client and server.
Built an automated scheduling system with Control-M that cut manual operational workload by 40%.
Optimised database performance by rewriting SQL queries, reducing execution time by 20%.
Streamlined data integration pipelines with DataStage, improving data accuracy and consistency across systems.
Mentored 10+ San Andrés College students through personalised Python tutoring, with a 100% success rate on their college projects.
Created a Python curriculum and coding workshops tailored to individual learning needs.
